settings_language_description: The language of the app and of the emails it sends you.
settings_language_error: Couldn't change the language. Try again.
settings_passkeys_unsupported_descriptio: This browser doesn't expose the WebAuthn API. Try a recent version of Safari, Chrome, Firefox, or Edge.
settings_passkeys_name_placeholder: e.g. iPhone, YubiKey, Mac Touch ID
settings_passkeys_empty: No passkeys yet. Add one above to skip the password on this device.
settings_passkeys_remove_confirm_descrip: The device that registered this passkey won't be able to sign in with it anymore. You can always add a new one later.
settings_2fa_code_mismatch: Code didn't match. Check your authenticator and try again.
settings_relations_error_not_guardian: You’re not a guardian of that dependent.
settings_profile_birth_year_tooltip: Optional. Used only to tailor recommendations and your experience. Never displayed publicly.
settings_profile_partner_description: When a partner is selected, gifts are typically shown as given by both of you.
settings_profile_anniversary_tooltip: Optional. Shared with your partner so it appears on both your profiles.
settings_profile_partner_confirm_named: You are currently partnered with {name}. Saving will unlink them and stop showing gifts as given by both of you.
settings_profile_partner_confirm_unnamed: Saving will unlink your current partner and stop showing gifts as given by both of you.
settings_profile_editors_dialog_descript: Your partner change affects who has editor access on some of your lists.
settings_profile_editors_add_heading_unn: Add Partner as an Editor On:
settings_profile_editors_remove_heading_: Remove Former Partner as an Editor From:
settings_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters
settings_password_too_long: Password must be {max} characters or fewer
settings_apps_connect_claude_description: Using Claude? One button opens Claude with everything filled in. Confirm there, then sign in and approve it here.
settings_apps_connect_other_description: For Cursor, ChatGPT, or any other MCP client, paste this server URL, then sign in and approve it when asked. {#link}Step-by-step guide{/link}.
settings_text_size_sample_notes: Over-ear, in black or navy. Noise cancelling would be great.
settings_text_size_description: Makes text and controls larger or smaller on this device only.
settings_avatar_crop_description: Drag to position, scroll or use the slider to zoom. The circle previews the final shape.
settings_avatar_crop_load_error: Couldn’t preview this image. Try a JPEG or PNG.
settings_permissions_guardian_locked: Guardians always have full access. Remove them as a guardian to change this.
settings_permissions_cannot_restrict: Partners and guardians cannot be set to restricted
settings_permissions_shared_edit: They've given you edit access to their lists
settings_permissions_shared_none: They haven't shared their lists with you
settings_permissions_shared_view: They share their lists with you
settings_permissions_help_label: What do these access levels mean?
settings_permissions_help_none: They can't see your lists or any items on them.
settings_permissions_help_restricted: They can view your lists and claim gifts for you, but they cannot see things that other people have purchased.
settings_permissions_help_view: They can see your public lists and the items on them, and claim items as gifts.
settings_permissions_help_edit: Everything View allows, plus they can create and edit lists and items on your behalf.
settings_2fa_description: Use an authenticator app to require a one-time code on every sign-in.
settings_2fa_enable_dialog_description: Enter your current password to begin enrollment.
settings_2fa_disable_dialog_description: Removes the TOTP requirement and clears all backup codes. Your account will fall back to password-only sign-in.
settings_2fa_step1_title: Step 1: Scan With Your Authenticator App
settings_2fa_step1_description: Open your authenticator and add a new account by scanning the QR code below. If you can't scan, enter the secret manually.
settings_2fa_account_hint: Account labeled {#strong}GiftWrapt{/strong}. The code rotates every 30 seconds.
settings_2fa_on_description: You'll be asked for a code from your authenticator app every time you sign in.
settings_2fa_regenerate_description: Invalidates any existing codes. Stash the new ones somewhere safe.
settings_2fa_backup_description: Each code is single-use. Use them if you lose access to your authenticator app.
settings_relations_description: Tag the people you shop for on Mother's Day and Father's Day.
settings_apps_page_description: AI assistants you have connected to your account. Each one acts as you, with the access you have. You can make one read-only or disconnect it here at any time.
settings_apps_disconnect_confirm_descrip: {name} will be signed out of your account immediately. You can connect it again later.
The assistant will be signed out of your account immediately. You can connect it again later.
settings_permissions_guardian_not_allowe: You can't change permissions for your guardian. They always have full access to your lists.
settings_permissions_restricted_not_allo: Some users cannot be set to restricted (partner or guardian relationships are always full view).
settings_permissions_page_description: Choose what each person can do with your wish lists. A green dot next to their name means they've shared their lists with you too.
settings_devices_page_description: Create an API key for each device that uses the mobile app. Each device gets its own key, so you can revoke a lost phone without signing out everywhere else.
settings_devices_empty: No device keys yet. Create one to pair a phone or tablet.
settings_devices_revoke_confirm_descript: {name} will be signed out of the mobile app immediately and will need a new key to sign back in.
This device will be signed out of the mobile app immediately and will need a new key to sign back in.
settings_devices_create_dialog_descripti: Give the device a name you'll recognize, like "My iPhone" or "Living room iPad".
settings_devices_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it manually.
settings_devices_minted_description: Copy this key and paste it into the mobile app now. You won't be able to see it again.
settings_devices_minted_warning: Treat this like a password. If it leaks, revoke it from this page and create a new one.
settings_dependents_page_description: People you receive gifts on behalf of (a pet, baby, or anyone managed by you). Ask an admin to add a new dependent or change guardians.
settings_dependents_empty: You aren't a guardian of any dependents yet.
settings_appearance_description: How the app looks on this device.
settings_security_description: Change your password and security settings.
settings_password_description: Change the password you use to sign in.
settings_passkeys_description: Add Touch ID, Face ID, or hardware security keys as a faster way to sign in. Each device gets its own passkey.
settings_profile_name_too_long: Name must be {max} characters or fewer
settings_profile_birth_day_invalid: Birth day must be between 1 and 31
settings_profile_birth_year_invalid: Birth year must be between 1900 and the current year
settings_profile_anniversary_invalid: Anniversary must be a valid date
settings_profile_child_partner: Child accounts cannot have a partner.
